journal.text:
First session; no prior journal. Deployed $44.5k of $50k across 15 names, ~11% cash buffer. Context: through 2025-12-31 the market pulled back broadly from mid-Dec highs; leadership is concentrated in AI/semis plus select healthcare, so I sized moderately and spread across sectors to avoid single-theme risk.

Semis/AI (NVDA, AMD, LRCX, MU, ASML; ~33% of book): best 3-mo relative strength (MU +71%, AMD +32%, LRCX +28%, ASML +11%) with NVDA/ASML consolidating after large runs; kept MU small given its parabolic move. Mega-cap: GOOGL (top 3-mo, +29%), AAPL, AMZN in steady uptrends. Healthcare: ISRG, REGN, VRTX in strong uptrends. Ballast/non-tech: WMT, ROST (+18% 3mo), MNST, MAR.

Deliberately avoided clear downtrends: NFLX, TMUS, MELI, META, PANW, CRWD, COST, ORLY, VRSK, ADP, MSFT (mild); left AVGO out after its sharp Dec breakdown.

Reassess if: broad market breaks the Nov-21 2025 lows (risk-off -> raise cash); any holding breaks its 3-mo trend or falls >15% from entry (trim); next monthly deposit (~Feb 1) adds cash to deploy. Re-scan momentum each session.

Jan 2 (observed through 2026-01-02) was a semis/memory surge: MU +10.5%, ASML +8.8%, LRCX +8.1%, AMD +4.3%, while mega-cap tech and some healthcare fell (AMZN -1.9%, AAPL -0.3%, ISRG -0.8%, VRTX -0.3%). Leadership remains narrow (AI/semis). No holding is >15% below entry and the broad market has not broken the Nov-21-2025 lows, so no forced de-risking.

Actions: Full exit AMZN - weakest 3-mo (+3%) and 1-mo (-3%); broke to the low of its range on above-average volume on a strong semis day. Partial trim AAPL (~31%, 4 sh) - +6% 3-mo but a clear downtrend from the Dec-2 high (271 vs 286), below short-term MAs. Redeploy into strong-but-not-parabolic leaders: AMD $1.8k (broke out of its Dec base, still ~15% below its Oct high), MAR $1.2k, ROST $1.2k, REGN $1.2k (all at/near highs with steady uptrends). Deliberately did NOT add to MU/ASML/LRCX after their +8-10% single-day spikes (extended/parabolic risk). Held NVDA (laggard but recovering off ~170 support), GOOGL (flat 1-mo, strong 3-mo), and healthcare/ballast (ISRG, VRTX, WMT, MNST).

Book stays ~90% invested with ~8% cash. Reassess if: market breaks the Nov-21 2025 lows (raise cash); any holding breaks its 3-mo trend or falls >15% from entry (trim); the semis blow-off reverses (trim LRCX/MU/ASML/AMD); the Feb-1 deposit adds cash to deploy.

Observed through 2026-01-05. Two-day semis/memory surge (MU +10.5% then -1%; LRCX +8%/+5%; ASML +8.8%/+5.5%) ended Jan-5 with intraday reversals: AMD opened a new high 230.25 but closed 221.08 below the prior close on high volume, NVDA 192->188.12, MU faded 325->312. Meantime breadth is weak: mega-cap tech rolling over (MSFT 472, META 659, AMZN choppy, AVGO 343 after its Dec breakdown, NFLX 91.5, PLTR 174 post-crash, COST/CRWD/PANW down), healthcare soft (AMGN, REGN, VRTX), staples/utilities soft (PEP, AEP, XEL). Leadership is narrow and extended = blow-off risk, so I reduce risk to ~17% cash.

Actions: full exit AAPL (clear downtrend from 286, weakest mega-cap). Trim extended semis to lock gains: AMD -8sh (key reversal day), LRCX -6sh, MU -3sh, ASML -0.9sh. Trim REGN -1.5sh (broke its Dec uptrend, below cost). Hold core NVDA (consolidating near cost), GOOGL, and non-tech ballast. Redeploy modestly into steady non-semi strength: LIN $2.8k (defensive industrial gases, orderly uptrend to new highs) and ODFL $1.0k (fresh base breakout). Deliberately NOT chasing the parabolic names.

Reassess if: semis resume/confirm leadership (re-add); market breaks the Nov-21-2025 lows (raise more cash); breadth broadens materially (increase exposure); holdings break 3-mo trend or fall >15% from entry (trim); Feb-1 deposit adds cash to deploy.

Observed through 2026-01-06. Jan-6 was a strong, broad rebound: memory/equipment semis confirmed leadership (MU +10% to 343 on 49M vol, LRCX +6.3% to 207, KLAC +14% in two days, ASML +1.1%) and breadth broadened (AMZN +3.4% breakout to 241 on 54M vol, ISRG +4.7%, VRTX +4.4%, MAR +3.5%, COST and SNPS to new highs, PDD/MELI strong). The Jan-2 sharp-drop-then-V-recovery plus improving breadth says the narrow-leadership fear is easing, but the memory names are now parabolic and mega-cap leaders AAPL/TSLA/NFLX remain broken. So I re-add risk selectively, not by chasing the spikers.

Actions: full exit AMD (13.52sh, ~$2.9k) - the clear semi laggard, reversed off the Jan-5 high 234 with a lower close on rising volume, not participating in the AI/memory move. Redeploy into less-extended strength: AMZN $2.5k (re-entry; genuine breakout on heavy volume, quality cloud/AI mega-cap), SNPS $1.5k (EDA/semi-design, orderly stair-step uptrend to new highs), PDD $1.3k (China e-commerce, steady uptrend breakout on volume). Hold core semis NVDA/LRCX/MU/ASML, healthcare (ISRG/REGN/VRTX), non-tech ballast (WMT/ROST/MNST/MAR/LIN/ODFL). Cash falls to ~13%.

Reassess if: MU/LRCX/KLAC blow-off reverses (trim extended semis hard); broad market breaks the Nov-21-2025 lows (raise cash); AMZN/SNPS/PDD break their breakout levels (cut); Feb-1 ~$50k deposit arrives to deploy on confirmed leaders.

Observed through 2026-01-07. Jan-7 was a mixed consolidation inside an intact uptrend, with leadership BROADENING away from the extended semis. Semis cooled as a group (MU -1.1%, LRCX -1.9%, ASML -1.1%, KLAC -2.5%, AMAT -1.3%, MRVL -4%, MPWR -4.6%, AMD -2%), but my holdings fell less than the group and remain well above entry, so per my Jan-7 plan (blow-off NOT reversed) I HOLD core semis NVDA/LRCX/MU/ASML. Mega-cap tech stays broken (AAPL 260 downtrend, TSLA 431, NFLX 90.7, META -1.8%); GOOGL +2.4% to a new high is the exception. New strength: cybersecurity jumped (PANW +4.3% breaking its Dec 186-190 range on 7.6M vol; CRWD +4.5% breaking its range top on 4M vol) and EDA/healthcare (SNPS, CDNS, REGN, VRTX) confirmed.

Actions: deploy part of the ~$6.5k cash into fresh, diversifying leadership rather than chasing the cooling semis. BUY PANW $2.5k and CRWD $1.5k (cybersecurity base breakouts on volume - a distinct group vs my semi/EDA/healthcare exposure). Hold everything else; cash falls to ~$2.5k (~5%). No holding is near the -15% trim trigger.

Reassess if: MU/LRCX/ASML break hard (trim extended semis); PANW/CRWD fail back below breakout ~186/~468 (cut); AMZN/SNPS/PDD break their breakout levels (cut); broad market breaks the Nov-21-2025 lows (raise cash); the Feb-1 ~$50k deposit arrives to deploy on confirmed leaders.

Observed through 2026-01-08. Jan-8 was rotation, not a broad selloff: semis/memory cooled a third day (MU -3.7% to 327 off its 343 Jan-6 peak, ASML -2.8%, NVDA -2.2%, LRCX -1.0%) and the two cyber breakouts gave back ground (CRWD -3.1% to 463.87, PANW -1.6% to 190.80). But leadership broadened: GOOGL 325.4 and AMZN 246.3 made new highs, and MAR 324.9, ROST 189.3, LIN 439.7, ODFL 171.1 all fresh highs, with WMT/MNST firm. Uptrend intact; the baton is passing from an extended semi complex to mega-cap tech and non-tech cyclicals.

Actions: (1) SELL CRWD full (3.137sh, ~$1.46k) - my Jan-8 plan said cut if it failed back below the ~468 breakout; it closed 463.87, back below the Dec 468-489 range on the retest, so the breakout is invalidated. (2) SELL MU 2sh (~$654) - partial trim of the most parabolic memory name after its 3-day stall off 343; lock part of the gain but keep a core position since the trend has not broken hard. Hold all other 17 positions; none is near the -15% trim trigger. Cash rises to ~$4.6k (~9%) as dry powder ahead of the Feb-1 ~$50k deposit.

Reassess if: semis break down further (MU loses ~315 / LRCX ~195 / ASML ~1170) - trim more; PANW loses ~186 - cut; AMZN loses ~240 or SNPS ~508 - cut; broad market breaks the Nov-21-2025 lows - raise cash; Feb-1 deposit - deploy into confirmed leaders.

Observed through 2026-01-09. Uptrend intact and broad. Jan-9 was a strong broad session: the semi complex that had cooled 3 days snapped back hard (LRCX +8.7% to new high 218.36, MU +5.5% to 345.09 back near its Jan-6 peak, ASML +6.7% to 1273.88), and leadership confirmed across mega-cap tech (GOOGL new high 328.57, AMZN new high 247.38) and non-tech cyclicals (MAR 328.18, ROST 191.44, LIN 444.08, ODFL 173.13 all fresh highs). COST broke out 883->915->925 on ~2x volume. Laggards stay PLTR, MSTR, ARM, SHOP.

Portfolio: all 18 holdings at/near entry and none near the -15% trim trigger; my prior cut levels (MU ~315/LRCX ~195/ASML ~1170/PANW ~186/AMZN ~240/SNPS ~508) were NOT hit and semis actually re-accelerated, so NO sells. I do not chase the extended semis. Action: deploy a slice of the $4.6k cash into COST $2.3k - a fresh, volume-confirmed new-high breakout in quality defensive-growth that diversifies away from the semi/tech-heavy book. Hold everything else; keeps ~$2.3k dry powder for the Feb-1 deposit.

Reassess if: semis reverse hard (LRCX loses ~205, MU ~325, ASML ~1200) - trim the extended trio; PANW loses ~184 - cut; AMZN loses ~240 / SNPS ~508 / COST loses ~875 - cut; broad market breaks the Nov-21-2025 lows - raise cash; Feb-1 ~$50k deposit - deploy into confirmed leaders.

Observed through 2026-01-12. Uptrend still intact and AI/semi-led, but the tape is narrow. Jan-12 continued the Jan-9 leadership: LRCX new high 220.40, ASML new high 1281.23, KLAC new high 1428.17, AMAT 307.24, AVGO 352.21, plus GOOGL new high 331.86, COST new high 943.08 (my Jan-12 add), SNPS new high 533.42, WMT a big-volume breakout to 117.97 (49M vs ~12M avg), ROST 192.26 and ODFL 173.57 fresh highs. Against that, old-tech/laggards stayed weak (AAPL 260 downtrend, META 641.97 down, NFLX 89.41, ADBE 327.65, INTU 635.44, QCOM -4.8% to 169.27, ARM 111.14) and some of my healthcare/China names faded (REGN -3.5% to 768, VRTX 460.59, ISRG 572.75, PDD 118.73). Narrow, parabolic-adjacent AI leadership = higher reversal risk, so I want to keep a buffer.

Portfolio: all 18 holdings at/near entry and none near the -15% trim trigger; my cut levels (MU ~315, LRCX ~195, ASML ~1200, PANW ~186, AMZN ~240, SNPS ~508, COST ~875) were NOT hit, so NO sells. I do not chase the extended semis. Cash is only ~$2.3k (~4.4%); rather than force it into a gap-up (WMT) or an already-extended leader, I HOLD it as dry powder for the Feb-1 ~$50k deposit. No orders today.

Reassess if: semis reverse hard (LRCX loses ~205, MU ~325, ASML ~1200) - trim the extended trio; PANW loses ~184 - cut; AMZN loses ~240 / SNPS ~508 / COST loses ~875 - cut; REGN or VRTX breaks to new lows below their Dec ranges - cut the healthcare laggards; broad market breaks the Nov-21-2025 lows - raise cash; Feb-1 ~$50k deposit - deploy into confirmed fresh leaders (WMT/ORLY-type volume breakouts, and any semi pullback that holds trend).

Observed through 2026-01-13. Choppy, narrow session: AI/semi leadership mixed (LRCX -2.7% to 214.38, MU -2.2% to 338.13, ASML -0.9% to 1270) but AVGO 354.61 and KLAC 1441.82 made new highs and AMD surged +6.4% to 220.97 on ~2x volume; GOOGL new high 335.97; WMT continued its volume breakout 117.97->120.36; COST/ROST/MAR/LIN firm. Against that, sharp distribution/reversals appeared: ADBE -5.4%, PDD -5.4% on ~3x volume, SNPS -3.5% outside-day reversal off a new 535.20 high, ARM -3%, QCOM -2.4%. Old-tech laggards (AAPL 261, META 631, NFLX 90) stay weak.

Portfolio: none of my cut levels were hit (LRCX 205 / MU 325 / ASML 1200 / PANW 186 / AMZN 240 / SNPS 508 / COST 875), so no leader exits. Action: SELL PDD full (10.69sh, ~$1.2k) - it gapped down 118.73->112.42 and closed near the low at 112.32 on 20.3M vs ~9M avg, breaking its Jan range; weakest holding (~-7.6% vs cost) and a genuine distribution break, so I remove it and raise dry powder. Hold all 17 others. SNPS is on watch (bearish reversal at highs, cut if it loses 508); AMZN is near its 240 cut; REGN/VRTX still above their Dec lows. Cash rises to ~$3.5k; I keep it as powder for the Feb-1 ~$50k deposit rather than chasing the extended semis.

Reassess if: semis reverse hard (LRCX loses 205, MU 325, ASML 1200) - trim the extended trio; SNPS loses 508 - cut; PANW loses 186 - cut; AMZN loses 240 - cut; REGN/VRTX break to new lows below their Dec ranges - cut; broad market breaks the Nov-21-2025 lows - raise cash; Feb-1 ~$50k deposit - deploy into confirmed fresh leaders.

Observed through 2026-01-14. Risk-off rotation: high-beta/momentum sold hard (APP -7.6% on ~2.3x vol, INTU -6.4%, SHOP -6.0%, AVGO -4.2% on 30M, MSFT -2.4%, BKNG/CRWD/FTNT/ARM weak) while defensives/staples/utilities led (PEP new high 145.92, KHC +3.4%, MDLZ +2.3%, KDP, XEL/AEP/EXC, TXN +2.6%, GILD +1.9%, AMGN +1.4%, CSX +1.5%). Semis cooled (LRCX 208.79, MU 333.35, ASML 1263.72, AMAT -0.6%, KLAC flat) after AVGO broke. My leaders held: GOOGL 335.84, COST new high 950.98, WMT 120.04, ROST 191.83, MAR 319.68, LIN 439.98, MNST 77.73, ODFL 173.52.

Actions (rule-based cuts of broken names): SELL AMZN full (10.43sh) - closed 236.65 near its low, below my 240 cut, lost the Jan breakout. SELL SNPS full (2.95sh) - 505.34 below my 508 cut after the bearish reversal from 535. SELL ISRG full (6.18sh) - gapped down, closed 546.76 on 3.6M (2.4x avg), ~4.5% under its 20-day (~572), healthcare devices leading the decline; cut the laggard. Hold the other 15 (LRCX/MU/ASML above cuts; PANW 190.93 ok; COST fine). REGN 754.14 / VRTX 449.53 still above their Dec lows - watch.

Cash rises to ~$10.8k (~21%); I keep it as dry powder rather than chase a one-day rotation - momentum breakdowns + cooling semis argue for patience ahead of the Feb-1 $50k deposit.

Reassess: LRCX 205 / MU 325 / ASML 1200 - trim extended semis; PANW 186 - cut; REGN/VRTX break below Dec ranges - cut; broad market breaks Nov-21-2025 lows - raise cash further; leadership reasserts (semis reclaim highs or a fresh volume breakout) - deploy toward fully invested.

Observed through 2026-01-15. Semis gapped up hard but faded: LRCX opened 228.15 (prev 208.79) and closed 217.47 near the low (15.2M); AMD 227.90->238.35->227.92; AMAT 328->319; ASML 1353.64->1331.60. Only KLAC was clean (new high 1544.96, +7.7%, 1.66M vs ~0.9M). Gap-and-fade on a huge up-gap = profit-taking; I do NOT chase the semis. My staples/industrials leaders stayed firm: COST new high 956.75, MAR 325.79, ODFL new high 178.21 (+2.7%), ROST 193.79, WMT 119.20 holding its breakout, LIN 440, MNST 77.91. GOOGL 332.78 (bearish reversal off 337.69).

Healthcare broke down - clear cut trigger. SELL REGN full (3.93sh, 741.92): 6 straight down days off 812 (Jan-7), at/below its Dec low (~739-749); weak. SELL VRTX full (5.50sh, 438.92): new low under its entire Dec/Jan range (prior low ~443), -10% off the Jan-7 487 peak. Both are the laggards (same group as the ISRG cut).

Deployed the freed cash into clean, non-semi breakouts: BUY CPRT $2.5k (41.25, +3.2% to new high on 12.2M vs ~8.5M avg - base breakout); BUY FAST $2.2k (43.53, +2.6% new high, 10.7M vs ~8M); ADD ODFL $1.8k (178.21, fresh high on rising volume). Avoided chasing the gapped semis and the weak software/cyber complex. Hold PANW (187.73, still above my 186 cut, but next to go). Cash ~$9.7k (~17%) plus the Feb-1 $50k deposit.

Reassess: PANW loses 186 - cut; LRCX 205 / MU 325 / ASML 1200 - trim semis; GOOGL loses 325 - warning; broad market breaks Nov-21-2025 lows - raise cash; semis hold their gaps (close near highs, follow-through volume) - deploy further into CPRT/FAST/ODFL-type breakouts and Feb-1 deposit.
